o.text: From Ottoman Turkish فرچه, from Medieval Greek βρούτζα (broútza). Cognate with English brush, German Bürste.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *kānat. Cognate with Turkish kanat, Kazakh қанат (qanat), etc.
Borrowed from Persian سرحد (sarhad), from Persian سر (sar) + Arabic حَدّ (ḥadd).

glosses: to chase one another, to surpass one another
